Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Distressed Vintage Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Blue
Colors: Blue
Materials: stone
80% Nylon, 20% Cotton Imported Inspired by timeless design, this rug combines charming vintage, weathered touches with modern low-maintenance materials. Made of natural and synthetic fibers in a rich blue palette, it adds soft texture and lasting style to your décor. Fashionable distressed vintage pattern Tufted in India. Durable for high traffic areas 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
